methods: Exact source hash verification and immutable input copies
Exact functions loaded without __main__; process/I/O/sleep mocked for pure probes
positive_checks: Fresh isolated profile/workspace and exact candidate/bundle hashes checked before launch
One NativeWorkspaceChoose request frame; raw request and full raw reply retained including error.message
Named pipe server PID checked before request and after reply; core image/creation/hash and witness continuity checked
Helper timeout reaches hold without retry or forced product termination; close uses existing identity-bound WM_CLOSE helper

findings.issue: Popen is followed by spawn receipt I/O before returning the handle; caller only then assigns desktop or appends children. A receipt exception leaves a live child missing from the holding registry.
findings.required: Register the child handle/identity in a shared registry immediately after successful spawn, before any fallible receipt operations; failure path uses that registry.

findings.issue: hold has no validated Root release or independently observed absence exit path. Its own save/print or sleep interruption can escape, so it both lacks safe reconciliation and fails its stay-alive contract.
findings.required: Use the corrected shared Root-release contract with bundle and known-PID observations, repeated clean scans and resilient diagnostics; never exit on unresolved or reporting failures.

findings.issue: RESULT proves only pair absence after WM_CLOSE, without desktop returncode or witness retirement. It must not be promoted to clean product shutdown.
findings.required: Explicitly label only pair absence, or additionally prove zero desktop exit and retired witness before claiming clean shutdown.

limitations: PowerShell synchronous pipe read has no internal timeout; Python observes 60 seconds then retains client and product processes in hold. This is intentional unresolved behavior, not a completed exchange.
No native action authorized by this review; no live pipe, chooser, WM_CLOSE or real process observed.
